title: Dockerizing FastAPI
description: Containerize your application using Docker for consistent deployment.

slides.title: Why Docker? 🐳
slides.content:
# Containers for Consistency

Docker packages your app and its dependencies into a lightweight container, ensuring it runs the same everywhere (development, staging, production).

**Benefits:**
- Isolated environment
- Easy scaling
- Simplified dependency management
- Works with orchestration (Kubernetes, Docker Swarm)

slides.title: Sample Dockerfile
slides.content: Create a `Dockerfile` in your project root.
slides.codeSnippet:
# Use official Python image
FROM python:3.11-slim

# Set working directory
WORKDIR /app

# Copy requirements and install dependencies
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

# Copy the rest of the application
COPY . .

# Run the app with Gunicorn
CMD ["gunicorn", "main:app", "-w", "4", "-k", "uvicorn.workers.UvicornWorker", "--bind", "0.0.0.0:8000"]

slides.title: Building and Running
slides.content:
```bash
# Build the image
docker build -t my-fastapi-app .

# Run the container
docker run -p 8000:8000 my-fastapi-app
```

For development with hot-reload, you can mount your code and use `--reload` flag.
slides.codeSnippet:
docker build -t my-fastapi-app .
docker run -p 8000:8000 my-fastapi-app

quizData.question: What is the primary advantage of using Docker for deployment?

options.text: It makes the app run faster
It ensures consistent environments across development and production

quizData.explanation: Docker containers package the application and its dependencies, providing consistency across environments.
